# STEREO VIBE

> A one-click starter kit (published as StereoVibe Lite) that turns a bare Windows or
> macOS machine into a working AI-coding setup: it installs Git, Node, Python and a
> coding-agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex or Gemini), checks sign-in and which AI services the
> network can reach, then, if you agree, scaffolds the agent's project memory — a
> CLAUDE.md plus a memory/ folder pre-filled from the checks it just ran.

Two self-contained scripts, no dependencies, no keys. The console UX is Russian; exit
codes and the JSON report are language-neutral. It sends an anonymous summary by default
(fixed list of fields, no names or paths); -NoReport / --no-report turns it off.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): what it does step by step, install, how to read the output, what leaves the machine, design decisions, limitations
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): constraints that are not visible in the code

## Code
- [Windows launcher](windows/Запустить%20Vibe.cmd): ASCII-only, self-elevates through UAC; `/check` = check only
- [Windows core](windows/_не%20трогать/check-work-tools.ps1): checks, installs, WinGet repair, project memory
- [macOS launcher](macos/Запустить%20Vibe.command): clears Gatekeeper quarantine on its own folder
- [macOS core](macos/_не%20трогать/check-work-tools.sh): the same checks over Homebrew, bash 3.2

## Memory templates
- [CLAUDE.md template](templates/CLAUDE.md): the rules the agent reads before touching anything
- [CLAUDE.ru.md](templates/CLAUDE.ru.md): the Russian original the workshop ships
- [infra_status template](templates/memory/infra_status.template.md): filled in by the installer from live detection, no identity
- [memory scheme](templates/memory/README.md): status is overwritten, history only grows, backlog lives in between

## Engine and commands
- [engine/](engine/): save_memory.py, save_prep.py, new_project.py — the idempotent memory writer
- [commands/](commands/): the eleven slash commands the memory runs on
